title: Towel Ring 6-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted With Concealed Screws | Spanish Gold | Towel Rings | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping hand towels over the counter—this wall-mounted towel ring keeps towels easy to grab and your bathroom vanity area tidy in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. This towel ring (also called a towel holder or towel hanger) is part of the coordinated Towel Rings collection, designed as transitional bathroom hardware that fits many styles.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Get a clean, finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Easy to coordinate across your bath with the towel rings collection of versatile bath accessories
- Dial in your style with multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Towel ring / towel holder / towel hanger
- Room: Bathroom / bath
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting style: Wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging; concealed screw installation
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs
- Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.
